v0.14.2 makes Git backup sync safer: a pull now applies all or nothing, and a force push is refused when it would drop commits on the remote. Damaged SQLite files no longer cost you real data, since only rebuildable indexes are deleted. Pages are easier to read: text, code and tables share one centered column. API keys (experimental) can now write, the install and update scripts verify the release checksum, and there are Linux 32-bit x86 binaries.

## 📝 Changelog for v0.14.0

PDFs now embed right in the page, LeafWiki speaks French and Simplified Chinese,
and admins can make the table of contents always visible. Most of the rest of
this release is hardening: how uploaded files are served, how sessions end after
a password change, and how search handles odd input.

### 🌟 Highlights

- **PDF embeds**: link a PDF and it renders inline in the page. Only same-origin
  PDFs are embedded; external ones and mobile get a file card with an open
  button.
- chore: bump modernc.org/sqlite (@dependabot[bot])

- **Reliability**: SQLite concurrency fixes with a new load-test suite, size caps on zip extraction during import/restore, and `api_keys.db` now included in backup/restore
- perf: fix SQLite concurrency bottlenecks found via load testing, add loadtest suite (#1366) (@perber)
- fix: include api_keys.db in backup/restore (#1374) (@perber)

**Driver API `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 3 → 4 is a hard cut.** The `(database, schema)` dimension is no longer carried implicitly by the session.
- **`use_database` is deleted** — the host no longer issues a `USE` statement before each read
- New `has_schema_level()` / `default_schema()`; `validate_schema_target(driver, database, schema, scope)` is the single rule both sides call
- **All 9 Redis driver locale packs** synced with 247 missing keys added, matching the driver's `en.ts` exactly.
